scenes.title: Taxi, Naya Mehmaan
narration: *Ek taxi Dev aur Sakshi ke ghar ke paas aakar rukti hai, Dev khushi khushi taxi ke paas jaakar uska darwaza kholta hai.*
*Neela taxi se bahar nikalte hi apne jiju ko hug karti hai.*
*Tabhi Sakshi paas aakar un dono ko thoda alag karti hai.*
Sakshi: "Aye badmash, mere pati se chipak mat."
Neela: "Oho dekho to jealousy kitni peak par hai didi ki."
*Teeno khilkhila uthte hain. Phir Dev Neela ka luggage uthata hai aur teeno ghar ke andar aa jaate hain.*
Sakshi: "Tere liye {{playerName}} ka kamra khali kar diya hai. Tu aaj se uske kamre mein rahegi."
Dev: "Seedhi ke neeche iska bistar laga diya hai."
*Dev ki baat sunkar Neela khilkhila uthti hai aur chidhane waali nazron se {{playerName}} ko dekhti hai.*
Neela: "Lagta hai mere aate hi tumhari value khatam ho gayi hai."
fallbackLines: *Neela apne luggage ke handle par ungliyan tap karti hai; uski aankhon mein shararat hai.*
Neela: "Toh, ghar ka tour milega ya tum pehle apni lost value wapas lene ka plan banaoge?"

choices.text: "Meri value theek hai—tum apne luggage ke saath pehle room dekh lo."

memory: The player answered Neela’s arrival tease; remember the exact tone and her reaction without assuming affection.

choices.text: "Welcome, Neela. Agar kisi cheez ki zaroorat ho toh bata dena."

memory: The player welcomed Neela and offered practical help; record how she responds and what she needs.

choices.text: "Mera kamra khali karne ka decision kisne liya? Mujhe bhi bata dete."

memory: The player raised a room/privacy concern; preserve the boundary and the family’s actual response.

choices.text: Apne shabdon mein kuch aur kaho ya karo.

memory: Preserve the player’s own first reply to Neela without supplying his dialogue.
